photos.llama_desc: A darkly lit stage with a person in a red and black costume, possibly a performer or actor, is seen in the center of the image. The person is wearing a red and black outfit with a long, flowing red and black skirt and a red and black top. They are standing on a stage with a white or light-colored floor, and there is a small, darkly lit area to the left of the person.
photos.oracle_desc: A very dark, blurry outdoor night scene with a small cluster of distant figures or lights — a green point of light and a faint red glow — visible near the center of an otherwise nearly black frame. No stage, performer, or costume is discernible; the setting appears to be an open outdoor area, possibly around a campfire or bonfire at night. Heavy motion blur and extreme underexposure make most details unresolvable.

photos.oracle_desc: An upward-angled shot of a large brick school building facade dominated by a blue banner reading "Collins Elementary / Michigan Exemplary Blue Ribbon School" and engraved lettering reading "Bruce D. Collins Elementary School." A girl stands at the far right edge of the frame, small in scale relative to the building. The composition emphasizes the signage rather than the subject.

photos.llama_desc: A young girl with long blonde hair and a black bow in her hair, wearing a pink, purple, and white patterned shirt, holding a small potted plant with green leaves and pink flowers, sitting at a white table with a blue plate and a piece of paper with dirt and a plant stem.
photos.oracle_desc: A young blonde girl smiles at the camera while holding a small potted seedling with a bright pink flower, seated at a white table scattered with loose soil and a white paper sheet. She wears a colorful geometric-patterned shirt in shades of pink, purple, and black and has a dark hair clip rather than a bow. A blue plate sits at the edge of the table in the background.

photos.llama_desc: A woman in a blue jacket and pink Hello Kitty-patterned pants is reaching for an object on a black metal structure in front of a brick wall. She has her back to the camera and her right hand is reaching up to grab something. Her left hand is holding a green plastic bag.
photos.oracle_desc: A girl in a teal hoodie and pink pajama pants climbs a black decorative iron trellis mounted against a brick house exterior, reaching upward with both hands. A second young girl is partially visible at the left edge of the frame, carrying a colorful bag. The scene appears to be an outdoor play moment on a cloudy day.

photos.llama_desc: A man in a blue and white plaid shirt, blue jeans, and white sneakers is guiding a young girl in a pink and white helmet, pink and blue jacket, blue and pink pants, and white sneakers as she rides a blue and silver bicycle on a sidewalk. The man is holding the girl's left hand and guiding her through a grassy area. The girl is wearing a pink and white helmet and a pink and blue jacket.
photos.oracle_desc: A man in a blue plaid flannel shirt and jeans jogs alongside a toddler riding a small balance bike on a concrete sidewalk, with his arms extended near her but not gripping her hand. The girl wears a pink helmet and a bright pink puffy jacket. Bare winter trees and a school building are visible in the background under clear afternoon light.

photos.llama_desc: A collection of postcards from the Swiss Alps. The postcards are arranged on a white surface, with some of them facing upwards and others lying flat. They feature various images of the Swiss Alps, including mountains, trains, and scenic views.
photos.oracle_desc: Approximately a dozen postcards featuring Swiss Alpine scenery are spread out in a fan arrangement on a white backdrop. Several cards prominently show red Rhaetian Railway trains crossing stone viaducts or ascending mountain passes, and at least one card displays the Matterhorn. The collection appears to be a curated set of Swiss railway and landscape souvenirs.

photos.llama_desc: A group of five children in white t-shirts and blue shorts, with one child in a red t-shirt, standing on a dirt path in a forest. The children are looking at something on the ground, with one child in a red t-shirt holding a small object. The background is a forest with trees and greenery.
photos.oracle_desc: Four children in white t-shirts and grey or khaki shorts stand clustered together on a dirt path in a wooded area, gathered around a rope hanging from a tree above them. None of the children is wearing a red shirt. The shaded forest setting with dense green foliage fills the background.

photos.llama_desc: A young girl in a pink and white helmet, riding a black and silver bicycle with a black seat and handlebars, on a concrete driveway in front of a white garage door. She is wearing a purple and pink tie-dyed shirt, blue jeans, and red and white sneakers. The girl's long blonde hair is tied in a ponytail and she has a pink and white helmet on her head.
photos.oracle_desc: A young blonde girl rides a small black balance bike on a wide concrete driveway, leaning slightly forward with her feet off the ground. She wears a pink helmet, a purple tie-dye long-sleeve shirt with a heart graphic, and blue jeans. A white two-car garage door and the corner of a brick house are visible behind her.

photos.llama_desc: A woman in a plaid shirt and a girl in a dark grey sweater are hugging in front of a tree with pink flowers. The woman is holding a phone in her hand. The background is a white building with a stone wall.
photos.oracle_desc: Two young women embrace and smile in front of a cherry blossom tree laden with pink blooms, with one wearing a plaid shirt and the other a grey knit sweater. Neither person is holding a phone. The image is rotated 90 degrees sideways, and a light-colored building facade is partially visible in the background.

photos.llama_desc: A group of swimmers in various swimsuits and caps, some on the starting blocks, others in the pool, with a few others in the background. The swimmers are all wearing different colored swimsuits and caps, with some wearing goggles and others not. The background is a pool with a few people in the background, including a few people in the pool and others on the poolside.
photos.oracle_desc: A large group of competitive female swimmers, numbering well over a dozen, stand at the starting blocks along the edge of an indoor pool, preparing for a race at what appears to be a swim meet. All athletes are at the blocks — none are yet in the water — wearing one-piece competitive suits in black, navy, red, and other colors, many with swim caps. An overhead scoreboard and sponsor banners are visible on the back wall.
